name: Sopwith
blurb: Sopwith is a modern port of the classic 1980s shoot 'em up game of the same name.
description:
Sopwith is a modern port of the classic 1980s shoot 'em up game of the
same name. The game has a World War I aviation theme. The object of
Sopwith is to destroy all enemy targets with a somewhat limited airforce.

It can be played both in single player and multiplayer mode over a TCP/IP network.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
